businesses.business: wood products manufacturing and building materials distribution

offering_description.value: Manufactures engineered wood products and plywood, and operates a large wholesale network distributing building materials. Sells to retail lumberyards, dealers, homebuilders and industrial customers through its own mills and distribution centers.

primary_products.value: engineered wood products (I-joists, laminated veneer lumber beams); plywood; lumber; particleboard

primary_services.value: wholesale distribution of building materials; logistics and delivery

customer_segment.value: B2B: retail lumberyards, home centers, dealers, homebuilders, industrial and construction customers

end_markets.value: residential construction; light commercial construction; home improvement and repair; industrial manufacturing

revenue_model.value: product sales: wood products made in mills and building materials resold through distribution

value_chain_position.value: distributor: buys building materials from manufacturers and sells to dealers, lumberyards and home centers; OEM / manufacturer: converts veneer and logs into plywood and engineered wood, sold to dealers and distributors

geography_served.value: North America: United States with distribution centers nationwide and some sales in Canada

specialization.value: related lines: building materials distribution and wood products manufacturing for construction

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned building materials distribution branches; direct sales: wood products sold directly to dealers and industrial customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental, forestry, workplace safety and building code rules, including EPA and OSHA
